required_completion: Keep both actual underlying committed/absent outcomes where applicable and the original uncertainty branch.
Use this as the independent minimum mapping for exact designed write sites. The final reviewed code must add its real read/check, implicit FK/index/WAL/VFS and platform fault cuts before execution.
This does not change the 108 semantic member identities or create new roots.

hook_oracles.before-first-write_or_after-write_or_bef: When the supervisor proves death/rollback before COMMIT entry, the current group is absent after verified recovery. Preserve earlier confirmed groups and charges.
hook_oracles.commit-fault: Inspect original complete identity/group and physical state after supported recovery; prove the actual committed or absent branch or retain unknown.
hook_oracles.commit-return: Record the real returned engine result separately. Missing/failed confirmation does not imply absent; verify the original before dependent action.
hook_oracles.confirmed-before-response: Recover the entire committed group and immutable original receipt. Do not repeat work, refill a charge or reuse a generation or permit.
